    CriticalNode from a pair with two extensions #

    CriticalPairNode asks, for a critical convex piece, only for a Kronecker pair on a convex piece whose two extension modules E(z₁), E(z₂) satisfy the relations of the cover. By respectsCover_generic the generic objects then satisfy them too, which is CriticalNode (criticalNode_of_pair).
